profile.headline: Software Devloper  at Porch Software
profile.summary: Lead Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in multiple industries e.g. utilities, healthcare, government military software, bioinformatics, data processing, and scientific research.  Strong engineering professional skilled in .Net Core C#, Micro-services, Azure Cosmos DB, Micro-services, Microsoft SQL Server, Vue.js, Requirements Analysis, Agile Methodologies, SQL and NoSQL Databases.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description:
•	On small team that designed and built transaction management full-stack system for processing customer utility transactions while mentoring junior developers, QA testers as the team grew.
•	MVP approach to a new transaction processing system.  Total of 15 repos with approximately 148 APIs with messaging. Designed both SQL and NoSQL databases. Developed front end with Vue.
•	Focus on an engine-based design, using configurations instead of code updates.
•	8.5 million transactions monthly, 2 million customers from 113 different energy suppliers and 78 brands.
•	Work to permanently fix daily fallout issues within a day. Goal not to repeat failures and design for self-healing system implementation
•	Completed over 550 User Stories in a years’ time.
•	Mentor new team members in industry, system tools and application understanding.
•	Known as the “Wiki Queen”, facilitated a process to update user stories with reference to wiki pages, to ensure updated documentation and testing scenarios.

positions.title: Sr Developer
positions.description: We developed new transaction processing system while migrating North Eastern utilities into the new system.  Practice MVP (Minimum Viable Product) development while migrating and processing transactions utilizing both Microsoft ATMS and ESG X12 translating services.

positions.title: Software Developer III
positions.description:
•	Acquired by Vistra Corp 
•	Support and maintenance Transaction Management System and Billing.  
•	Prototyped and presented a new outbound transaction processing approach which was accepted and implemented.  Minimized code changes by using file configuration definitions
•	Mentored interns and junior developers teaching energy utility processing as well as development and testing skills.
•	Started team building activities to help build team unity.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · Web Services · C# · Vue.js · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Stored Procedures · Test-Driven Development · .NET · REST APIs · Azure Cosmos DB · Microservices · Microsoft Azure
